svg.title: Sterile Processing as the Buying Center
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-sterile-processing-buying-center; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: Sterile Processing as the Buying Center; subtitle: Who buys around Central Sterile in ASC, veterinary and dental clinics; caption: Henry Schein Medical pitches autoclaves, instrument washers, sinks and cassettes as the room ASC owners overlook, while surgeons cut total knee trays from five to two.; assumptions note: No staffing counts were reported, so headcount is described qualitatively; spoke KPIs are the figures each practitioner stated.; note: Attributed to Henry Schein Medical, the American Association of Hip and Knee Surgeons (Drs. Ballard and Pickering), PEER at TAMU, and Nuronus.; center: role: Central Sterile processing; headcount: Shared processing room serving every surgical team; focus: Autoclaves, instrument washers, processing sinks, prep-and-pack, cassettes; spokes: role: ASC owner; type: Capital buyer; kpi: Bundles sterilizers, washers, sinks and cassettes from one vendor; role: Orthopedic surgeon; type: Cost champion; kpi: Knee trays 5 to 2; $750 saved per case vs ~$8,400 Medicare knee; role: Veterinary surgical team; type: Consumables buyer; kpi: Triple-wrapped packs rewashed and resterilized every 6 months; role: Dental practice; type: Compliance buyer; kpi: $4,000-8,000 initial; $500-1,500 per month retainer
